transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is that I keep getting up during things where I really shouldn't. Like, during sprint planning meetings for work, or even important mortgage calls. 

I know I'm supposed to just stay put and listen, but I'll suddenly feel like I need to get water right that second, or I'll just decide to get up and check something in the other room. It's been bothering me enough that I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.

{"intent": "Determine if the restlessness and difficulty staying seated have been present since childhood", "question": "Did you have similar trouble sitting still or staying in your seat when you were a child

Yeah, I did. Um, I remember back in elementary school, my teachers actually had to move my desk a few times. They were always reminding me to stay seated because I was just always popping up out of my chair. 

I'd also talk before I was called on, or, you know, I'd rush through my assignments even when I actually understood the work. So, yeah, it's definitely been an issue since I was a kid.
Aside from restlessness, do you often have trouble keeping your focus on work tasks or conversations?

Yeah, I do. Um, I can sit down to start reviewing a pull request for work, or reading through those mortgage documents with totally good intentions. But then, after just a few minutes, I'll realize I'm just staring at the exact same section and my brain is off thinking about five completely unrelated things. So, yeah, keeping my focus on the actual task is definitely a struggle too.
